services.name: Camp
services.desc: As school tapers off, we are excited to provide a fun and physical activity during the summer season. Focus Summer Camps are filled with fun climbing activities, both on and off the wall, and are designed with keeping your child learning and active. Summer Camps at Focus are limited in size (12 kids maximum), and guarantee more individual time with our professional instructors. Don’t pay big money for group babysitting. services.name: Programs (4)
services.desc: Camps are available for ages 6-12 years old, and activities will be centered on climbing- learning terminology, basic movement and technique. We offer kids yoga and several activities to work out their muscles throughout the week. Campers will provide their own lunch, and Focus has 2 snack breaks. Our Camp provides a great controlled environment for getting children active while they are out of school. Anyone under the age of 18 must have a waiver signed by a parent or legal guardian to enter the gym. The youth climbing team at Focus is a competitive and non-competitive junior climbing team for kids between the ages of 6 and 18. The entire coaching staff are certified USAC coaches.
